testCases.name: Live E2E - confirm, review and request another reconciliation
testCases.description: Runs the real client and server agents, supplies human confirmation, requests one additional reconciliation after the first result, then accepts. Requires deployed server processes and configured model/Connector secrets. Asserts client routing, not response wording, reconciliation correctness or A2A conformance.

variables.question: Northwind Electronics charged USD 49.95 twice for one order. The expected charge was USD 49.95. Review this synthetic example only. Delegate the reconciliation to the remote agent. If it requests confirmation, ask me using the confirmation form before sending the confirmed details.

variables.followUp: I confirm that these are synthetic demonstration values. Please reconcile them for human review.

variables.clientFeedback: Please delegate one more reconciliation of the same human-confirmed synthetic claim to the remote agent. The previous task is complete, so send a new request using its returned context. Reuse my existing confirmation; do not ask for it again. Show the new remote result for review.
